package.name: openarmx_pilz_box_align
package.description: Bimanual box-align via MoveIt Pilz planning (motion only). On an AlignToBoxes action goal, consume the latest detected boxes (/detected_boxes from box_perception_node), assign each to the nearer arm by base-frame Y, and move the assigned arm's link7 above its box at a commanded height/orientation by planning a Pilz LIN motion (/plan_kinematic_path service) and publishing the trajectory to the arm's JTC topic.
